launches.title: HYBRD - agentic coaching for athletes
launches.tagline: get faster and stronger
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re the team behind HYBRD - Ruiters, Shoe, Ben, Michael and Mats. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/b570d491-7243-4a3c-8660-ca425a646339)

We’re excited to share that today **HYBRD is becoming a coach in your pocket.** It’s like having a $500/month private coach on call 24/7. We provide a world-class training plan, then adapt it based on your life, progress, and recovery to keep you on track. 

\
[LINK TO DEMO VIDEO](https://youtube.com/shorts/PgPKkJqbYs0)

ASK: [TRY IT NOW ON THE APP STORE](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

\
**Introducing HYBRD Brain**

HYBRD Brain is our AI-powered coach built on top of HYBRD's structured training plans. Tell Brain about your schedule, sport mix, travel, or injuries — and it restructures your entire plan accordingly.

## **⭐ Why HYBRD is different**

These aren't ChatGPT-slop training plans.

We've partnered with Alex Viada (creator of the term "hybrid athlete") and his Complete Human Performance team to use their world-class programming as HYBRD's foundation. Our agent adapts those plans to you while preserving best-in-class athletic methodology.

(Alex also bought an iPhone just to use HYBRD)

**HYBRD Brain can coach you to achieve anything**

* Training for a marathon but also playing soccer twice a week? HYBRD Brain adjusts your running volume.
* Tweaked your Achilles and need to back off temporarily? HYBRD Brain rebuilds your training block.
* Traveling for work and missed three sessions? HYBRD Brain recalculates what comes next so you don’t lose momentum.

Instead of forcing you to follow a plan that breaks on contact with reality, HYBRD Brain builds a plan that adapts to you. 

**HYBRD actually does things**

Chatting with your health data is cool, but not useful. Most apps just regurgitate your charts back to you (you know how to read a graph) and recommend the CDC's 75 minutes of vigorous activity per week.

These tools feel disappointing because they don't know your actual goals and constraints, like upcoming races, equipment and your schedule, so they can't do anything meaningful with the data they collect.

HYBRD understands your goals and proactively proposes adjustments that fit your plan. Unplanned workouts, missed sessions, fatigue, cross-training, new PRs… HYBRD recognizes these moments and reorganizes your schedule around them.

**HYBRD uses ALL of your workout data**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet. 

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**HYBRD is adaptive to your history, current level and progress**

HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources, pulling in your full workout history and deduplicating it. From that data, we give you a holistic view of your strength and cardio fitness, normalized for age, gender, and weight, as a single score you can track over time.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting: we interpret it all to model your physiology and personalize your plan.

Say you want to train more like Alex Viada. You probably aren't deadlifting 700lbs and logging 15+ hours a week (yet?). We scale the fundamentals of his programming down to exactly where you are now.

**FitBench**

Ok, it wouldn't be an AI launch without benchmarking.

We built **FitBench**, a benchmark that evaluates an AI coach across four dimensions: Scientific accuracy, athlete safety, recommendation actionability and conciseness across 25 common coaching scenarios. We used Opus 4.6 as an LLM-as-a-judge to score HYBRD Brain against current ChatGPT and its predecessors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/c6e545d7-114b-4cc5-9e1f-806f7197e7d2)

But how does that compare with human coaches?

We had HYBRD sit for the **Certified Strength and Conditioning Specialist (CSCS)** exam, which is the gold standard in coaching. You need 70% to pass (half of all human test-takers don't make it). HYBRD scored 77%.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100595&key=user_uploads/1315661/4cfa2415-0d8f-4106-850b-f15fcf307d54)

\
**Our Story**

Ben, Mats, and Shoe all met while working on getting WHOOP to PMF. At the time, outside of work, Mats was training on the US national rowing team and Ben + Shoe were making their first forays into Ironman training.

We realized that fitness hardware was getting really good, but also was being commoditized. (Just take a look at Coros brutally undercutting Garmin prices)

For all the data being collected, existing products weren’t providing real coaching to multi-disciplinary “hybrid” athletes like us, partly because none were built to handle strength + cardio data, and partly because models weren’t good enough. 

Most athletes are still following static PDF plans they found online, or "adaptive" apps that fall apart the moment cross-training enters the picture.

We teamed up with our co-founder and CTO Ruiters (a senior AWS engineer at the time) and Michael (our founding engineer) to solve that with HYBRD. 

If that problem resonates with you, [try a 7 day free trial of HYBRD!](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875)

launches.title: HYBRD: Get faster & stronger
launches.tagline: World-class training plans personalized perfectly to you
launches.body:
**TLDR:** HYBRD (F24) is launching personalized strength + 5k/10k/half-marathon/marathon plans to make you faster and stronger! The training plans are by world-class coach Alex Viada, the guy who literally wrote the book that started the _hybrid athlete_ movement. We personalize his plans perfectly to you based on your data and preferences.

**You can check out a demo here:** https://youtube.com/shorts/WCzKPLmS_A4?feature=share

**Asks**

* Get ridiculously fit so that you live longer and show up as the best version of yourselves for your friends and families
* Do this by trying our 7 day free trial (find us on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-get-faster-stronger/id6670271875))
* Stay motivated by joining our free weekly workout clubs in San Francisco and Boston (email me at [mats@hybrd.app](mailto:mats@hybrd.app) to join the groupchat)
* Pay it forward by sharing HYBRD with the most athletic people you know

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/2636ea96-f4e3-4c5a-9fb9-03a49e4d7e30)

(pictured above is Alex Viada - if you’re not familiar, he wrote the first book on hybrid training and an inspiration to many, many coaches and athletes in this space. He bought an iPhone just to try HYBRD and we’ve since launched a partnership to provide his training plans on the platform)\
\
**Ok.. I want to be strong and fast, but what are you actually building?**

We break down the silos between your cardio, strength and wearable data to give you a complete view of your performance.

Then we use that data to personalize training plans from world-class coaches to you. We’re ex-WHOOP, ex-US national rowing team, triathletes / ultramarathoners ourselves and are building the training platform that we wish had existed for us.\
\
**Why do I need a separate app for this?**

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet.

It kinda works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter.

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Do it wrong and you risk “cardio killing your gains”

**What are you guys doing about it?**

First, HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources. We pull in as much historical data as we can. We pull in your workouts and deduplicate them.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/ea007cfa-7a37-4fe1-ac3a-cf3766489e8f)

Then, we make it really easy to track your weightlifting, CrossFit, HYROX - things that aren’t well suited for tracking on a wearable.

You can use text to input your workout to our AI logger - or, simply upload a picture of your training journal, a whiteboard from a HYROX gym, or a screenshot from an app you already use.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/d7b6ae82-a69f-44ef-85de-eafad05467e6)

Based on that data, we provide a holistic view of your strength and cardio abilities, normalized for age/gender/weight and give you a single score (analogous to a chess Elo score) that you can use to track your progress.

Cycling, running, rowing, lifting data can all be interpreted and used to model your physiology.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/40a31bf9-1e3d-4cf3-98e1-f8b3ea2cd8a4)

That gives us all the information we need to know to personalize a training plan for you.

For example - lets say you want to be more like Alex Viada, the guy I mentioned above. You might not deadlift 700lb+ and be training 15+ hours a week (yet?), so we can scale down the fundamentals of his training plan to whatever is right for you:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/316c1a00-295f-4498-a9a7-52a70ed43a06)

These training plans have been developed by likely the most reputable coaching organization in hybrid athletics - Complete Human Performance (shout out to Alex as well as Trevor Tartaglia and Ariana Scalfo!)

And once you have that workout plan, we can push it directly to your Garmin (Coros + Apple Watch coming soon), so you can easily run through the workout on the go.

You’ll be motivated to keep making progress by pushing up your Training Score, which is the first metric to encapsulate both strength and cardio training load, developed by us and Anna Cruse, the Director of Applied Health and Performance Science at the University of Utah.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/c04f9964-96e3-457c-a1e5-b03c8fd2fc8c)

**Where is this all going?**

We’ve already had hundreds of thousands of workouts get processed when HYBRD was a tracking-only app, so we’re really pumped about taking things to the next level by adding in adaptive programming.

We’re going to keep adding more plan types (HYROX, triathlon coming soon) as well as more personalization levers (probably sleep + recovery etc.)

Right now we’re iOS only but stay tuned on the Android side.

**Who are you to tell me how to get stronger + faster..?**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95448&key=user_uploads/1315661/3a16ba00-2b5e-4607-bda2-b0152ec649a2)

**Well, we’ve got a great team!**

(from left to right)

* our CTO [**@Matt Ruiters**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1833503) was a USA Rugby All-American and a former senior SWE at AWS
* [**@Caroline "Shoe" Shoemaker**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1862703) was the first analytics hire at WHOOP, later GM for a productivity app portfolio at Appex and is racing an Ironman this weekend
* CEO [**@Ben Katz**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1851275) led growth at WHOOP, later GM for a fitness app portfolio at Appex and is also racing an Ironman (against Shoe) this weekend
* Our founding engineer Michael Battaglia is a former WHOOP software engineer and rowed for Cornell
* [**@Mats Terwiesch**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/1315661) was a core product manager at WHOOP, was concurrently on the US National Rowing Team, ran a 50mi ultramarathon last weekend and previously published health + AI research at Harvard

and we’re just getting started!

launches.body:
**TL;DR**

HYBRD is the performance hub for modern athletes. We break down the silos between your cardio, strength and wearable data to give you a complete view of your performance. We’re ex-WHOOP, ex-US national rowing team, triathletes / ultramarathoners and are building the app that we wish existed for us.

After a great invite-only beta with hundreds of paying users, **we’ve just launched publicly on the** [**iOS App Store**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-hybrid-athlete-tracker/id6670271875)!

\
Full demo video here: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HOBtxG8r3m8>

**The problem** 

Every workout you do is a puzzle piece in a broader picture of performance. But fitness tracking data is siloed across multiple domains. You might track your running data on a Garmin, your sleep/recovery on WHOOP and your strength training in a spreadsheet. 

It works if you’re _just_ a runner or _just_ a lifter. 

But more and more people are becoming “hybrid” athletes who focus on strength _and_ cardio, so they’re left stitching together multiple data sources to see the full picture.

Until now. 

**Solution**

First, HYBRD integrates with all leading wearables and data sources. We pull in as much historical data as we can. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/1c56a0fe-5540-48db-9739-8d70739f7503)

Then, we make it really easy to track your weightlifting.

You can use text to input your workout to our AI logger - or, simply upload a picture of your training journal, a whiteboard from a HYROX/CrossFit gym, or a screenshot from an app you already use.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/649eacd0-e23e-4f46-8374-ae3e6a069399)

Based on that data, we provide a holistic view of your strength and cardio abilities, normalized for age/gender/weight and give you a single score (analogous to a chess Elo score) that you can compare with your training buddies.

\
We recently launched a trends feature so you can see all your data from all your data sources over time. And we’re working with one of the best coaches in the country to put together training plans for you (coming soon into the app) 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/fbb6c4d1-8d4d-48cb-a263-041ae6de0b43)

**Asks**

1. Try our 7 day free trial! \[[link to App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hybrd-hybrid-athlete-tracker/id6670271875)\]
2. Share our app with the most athletic people you know
3. Join our free weekly workout clubs in San Francisco and Boston (all welcome, contact us at [founders@hybrd.app](mailto:founders@hybrd.app), and let us know if you want a free Ironman 70.3 or marathon training plan)

**Team**

Three of our founders previously worked at WHOOP, each of us leading teams across product, growth and analytics. Our CTO, Matt, was a senior technical lead at Amazon AWS

We all are hybrid athletes ourselves - Mats was a member of the US national rowing team and Shoe, Ben and Ruiters have all completed Ironman 70.3s. 

Each of us felt underserved by existing fitness apps to the point where we tracked our workouts in Google Sheets, so we decided to build HYBRD.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/75a21bcd-311d-43cd-ba33-7451c9bdeb79)

Shoutout to the HYBRD Workout Club!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89832&key=user_uploads/1315661/e76b5fdc-8c51-4323-99c6-6b9365326cef)

launches.title: HYBRD: fitness OS for elite athletes
launches.tagline: Don't let cardio kill your gains.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

HYBRD is Strava for elite athletes who do more than just cardio. We’re ex-WHOOP, ex-US national rowing team, triathletes/ultramarathoners, and we are building the app that we wish existed for us.

**Problem**

Athletes who train **both strength and cardio** lack a unified way to track and visualize their training. They track cardio with apps like Garmin, Coros, WHOOP, or Strava and log strength workouts with others like Hevy, Strong, Stronglifts, or even good ol’ pen and paper.

This fragmented tracking makes it difficult to train effectively and impossible to compete with friends who train in different disciplines.

**Solution**

First, HYBRD integrates with **all leading wearables** to pull in your runs, rides, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85200&key=user_uploads/1315661/3c50b8d2-8148-4906-b8a5-05904686ec4a)

Then, we make it really easy to track your weightlifting.

You can input your workout to our AI logger using text— or simply **upload a picture of your training journal**, a whiteboard from a CrossFit gym, or a screenshot from an app you already use.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85200&key=user_uploads/1315661/7c27a8dd-957c-4b2e-a295-2142cde54835)

Based on that data, we provide a holistic view of your strength and cardio abilities, normalized for age/gender/weight, and give you a **single score** (analogous to a chess Elo score) that you can compare with your training buddies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85200&key=user_uploads/1315661/073cb4f1-96da-4693-8d15-b482766761a5)

In the coming weeks, we’ll be adding more detailed analyses and **competitive social features**.\
\
**Asks**

1. [Apply to join HYBRD](https://www.hybrd.app/?utm_source=ycombinator&utm_medium=launchyc)
2. Share this post with the most athletic people you know

**Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85200&key=user_uploads/1315661/3292afcd-5fce-4eeb-a45e-3a0d1e63b059)

Three of our founders previously worked at WHOOP, each of us leading teams across product, growth, and analytics. Our CTO, Ruiters, was a senior technical lead at Amazon AWS.

We are all hybrid athletes ourselves—Mats was a member of the US national rowing team, and Shoe, Ben, and Ruiters have all completed Ironman 70.3s. 

Each of us felt underserved by existing fitness apps— to the point where we tracked our workouts in Google Sheets— so we decided to build HYBRD.\
\
Check out our demo video here: <https://www.loom.com/share/a2e45f9575c5433483f9413305f35e52>

name: FutureClinic
long_description: FutureClinic is a platform that makes it easy for any doctor to open their own digital clinic. Our AI assistant takes a comprehensive medical history using an empathic chat or voice-based interface, uses sophisticated medical reasoning to narrow down likely diagnoses, and produces evidence-based treatment suggestions for each patient. Licensed doctors then review the text-based summaries of the cases our AI provides, and choose how to manage the patients. In this fashion, we're able to deliver end-to-end healthcare in a way that makes personalized, expert healthcare scalable to 8 billion people around the world.

launches.title: FutureClinic: Healthcare that's 99% AI, 1% doctor.
launches.tagline: We make it easy for any doctor or hospital to open their own AI-first digital clinic.
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

* Most AI healthcare companies have been focusing on administrative tasks (authorizations/ scribing). We’re focusing on the main bottleneck in healthcare - clinical expertise. Our AI thinks like a doctor.
* It conducts comprehensive medical histories via voice interface, performs medical reasoning, and suggests evidence-based treatments / next steps (99% of the healthcare journey).
* Doctors can efficiently review text-based summaries on a back-end dashboard in under a minute, and maintain final medical decision-making control (the high value 1%).

<https://youtu.be/cUoLpodvLwE?si=fUzpo4LD3y3rzqtT>

---

### **The Problem**

1. **Traditional healthcare delivery is broken, with a fundamental supply/demand mismatch between the need for healthcare, and the number of doctors available to provide it.**
2. **The US healthcare system is facing a physician crisis**
   * Projected shortage of 86,000 physicians by 2036
   * 30% of physicians are leaving the field or moving part-time in the next 5 years due to the lack flexibility or burnout.
   * Patient volumes per physician are exploding, overwhelming doctors' capacity to deliver quality care
3. **Existing attempts to solve these problems have been step changes, and fail to lessen the burden of care on doctors:**
   * Traditional Telehealth simply moved the same broken workflows online, amounting to the same workload, if not more (”I think you’re on mute, Mrs. Jones…”)
   * Asynchronous messaging currently requires a lot of back and forth and hasn’t achieved adoption
   * Administrative streamlining AI services are great, but don’t tackle the fundamental bottleneck in healthcare which is clinical expertise.

### **The Solution**

FutureClinic is an EHR platform that powers digital medical clinics with sophisticated AI that handles 99% of the work, letting doctors focus purely on medical decision-making.

Our platform:

* Takes comprehensive medical histories through an empathetic voice interface
* Uses advanced medical reasoning to narrow down diagnoses
* Provides evidence-based treatment suggestions
* Presents doctors with concise text-based summaries, with all key findings cited
* Enables asynchronous care delivery without video/phone calls
* Built-in safety protocols flag potential contraindications and risks.
* Closes care gaps for patients with language barriers

---

### **Our Vision**

* Our EHR starts by powering digital medical clinics, but we ultimately power healthcare delivery in brick and mortar clinics and hospitals too.

---

### **About Us**

* 3 out of 4 co-founders are medical doctors as well as software engineers from top institutions (UCL, Imperial College London, Mount Sinai)
* Combined experience of >10,000 real-world patient encounters, with a deep understanding of physician needs and pain points (and scar tissue to prove it!)
* In previous roles, we’ve directly helped open >40 real world medical clinics in New York in the last 3 years, and know what it takes to deliver end-to-end care in a legal, compliant, and safe manner.
* Our President has >300,000 followers on social media, largely doctors and medical students, giving us an unfair advantage for early distribution.

### **Reach out!**

_For Doctors_**:** If you're interested in starting your own digit clinic with complete flexibility and control, visit [**openclinic.com**](http://tryopenclinic.com) to sign up or email [**founders@openclinic.com**](mailto:founders@tryopenclinic.com)

_For Healthcare Organizations_**:** If you're looking to launch a digital clinic or use our system for patient intake, we'd love to discuss how OpenClinic can help. Email [**founders@openclinic.com**](mailto:riyan@tryopenclinic.com)

launches.tagline: We automate EMS quality reviews and billing, reducing errors, maximizing revenue, and improving patient care.
launches.body:
We’re Yos and Timmy – co-founders of [Amby Health](https://tryamby.com) 👋

# **TL;DR**

Ambulance agencies (EMS) waste time and lose revenue due to manual quality reviews and billing, leading to missed errors, under-documented care, and delayed reimbursements. Amby Health automates the entire process, ensuring 100% of patient reports (PCRs) are reviewed in real-time, helping agencies increase revenue, reduce workload, and improve patient care.

Know any **EMS Directors/CEOs or Fire Department Captains**? Please introduce us! 

Email: [contact@amby.health](mailto:contact@amby.health)

# **The Team**

**Yos (CEO):**  MIT dropout, ex-Meta engineer, ML researcher at MIT CSAIL, and former engineer at Allm, a company providing pre-hospital emergency care. He saw firsthand how outdated, manual EMS documentation and billing slow down providers and reduce revenue.

**Timmy (CTO):** – MIT dropout, ex-Amazon/Bloomberg engineer, AI researcher at MIT Media Lab, and healthcare data scientist at OM1. He saw how valuable insights are buried in unstructured medical records, making it hard for providers to act on critical data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87974&key=user_uploads/541108/0d47eceb-120d-4b66-acd1-d3f1a67db38a)

# **The Problem**

EMS quality reviews and billing are still manual and inefficient, leading to:

* **Missed Errors & Compliance Risks** – Incomplete patient reports (PCRs) slip through, leading to under-documented care, protocol violations, and legal exposure.
* **Lost Revenue & Billing Delays** – EMS teams spend hours fixing reports, chasing down medics, and resubmitting claims. Agencies miss out on millions due to denials, coding errors, and charge capture gaps.
* **Slow, Labor-Intensive Process** – Quality review and billing teams are bogged down by manual chart reviews and corrections, delaying reimbursements and patient care improvements.

 

# **Our Solution: AI-Powered EMS Quality Review & Billing**

✅ **Automated Quality Audits** – Identifies errors, missing documentation, and compliance risks instantly.\
✅ **Real-Time Medic Feedback** – Helps providers improve documentation and protocol adherence with instant insights.\
✅ **Billing Optimization** – Ensures complete PCRs, flags missed charges and reduces denials to speed up payments.

The result? EMS agencies recover lost revenue, cut review times, and improve patient care—while reducing manual work. 

One fire department **increased EMS revenue by 33%** (from $350K to $500K) simply by improving its review process.

# **Demo**

<https://youtu.be/eH2ddSKFZOI>

---

**Our Ask**

* Know any EMS Directors/CEOs or Fire Department Captains? Introduce us!
* Reach us at: [contact@amby.health](mailto:contact@amby.health)
* Learn more: [tryamby.com](http://tryamby.com)

Cenote helps online D2C brands convert more shoppers through AI sales reps that can call and text.

Online stores rely on static websites, one-way email and SMS campaigns, and inside sales teams with limited availability. But many purchases are better suited to a conversation: shoppers have questions, need guidance, or simply are not excited to buy based on what's on the site alone.

Today, those shoppers are poorly served. Abandoned-checkout campaigns are generic, call centers close, and slow human follow-up allows high-intent leads to go cold. Our customers often see conversion rates below 1% from traditional abandoned-checkout outreach.

Cenote's AI reps reach shoppers immediately, remember their context, and continue the conversation across channels and over time. This gives every interested shopper access to a personalized sales rep and helps brands recover revenue from leads they have already paid to acquire.

launches.tagline: Our AI sales agents immediately and persistently call and text your leads
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Telehealth clinics spend hundreds of thousands on ads but convert only a fraction of the patients who visit their site.

Buying GLP-1s, TRT, or other treatments is a high-stakes decision, yet most patients are left alone with a website.

Cenote provides AI sales agents that instantly reach out, answer questions, and guide patients through the purchase, helping clinics grow revenue and patients buy with confidence.

**Problem**

Telehealth customer acquisition is extremely expensive.

Clinics often pay hundreds, sometimes thousands, of dollars per lead, yet most visitors never convert.

After spending heavily to acquire demand, clinics rely on two imperfect tools:

* marketing automations with low engagement
* human reps who can’t scale coverage or response time

The result is lost revenue for clinics and confusing shopping experiences for patients making complex medical decisions.

**Insight**

High-consideration healthcare purchases shouldn’t be self-serve websites, they should be guided experiences.

Patients don’t abandon because they aren’t interested, they abandon because they have questions, uncertainty, or timing issues.

In the offline world, these purchases would involve a knowledgeable guide.\
Online, that layer has been missing.

We believe a new default is emerging: instead of navigating complex decisions alone, every buyer will have an intelligent concierge helping them evaluate, decide, and act.

**Solution**

Cenote gives every lead a personalized, persistent sales experience.

Our agents:

* reach out instantly via call and text
* answer questions and qualify needs
* follow up over days or weeks as patients decide
* support use cases like abandoned carts, failed payments, and win-backs

Every lead gets the experience of a dedicated care guide.

**The Impact**

Clinics using Cenote see:

* significantly higher conversion on existing traffic - for one clinic our agent converted at 2x the rate of a human rep
* better patient experiences

Instead of losing demand, they capture it.

**Why now**

AI can now hold natural, helpful conversations at scale.

For the first time, it’s possible to give every patient a guided buying experience, something previously only available to the highest-touch businesses.

**The ask**

We’re looking to speak with:

• Telehealth operators spending heavily on acquisition\
• Patients who recently considered an online health purchase

If that’s you (or someone you know), we’d love to talk.

We’d love your help!

launches.title: Cenote - Back office automation for specialist medical clinics
launches.tagline: Cenote eliminates administrative bottlenecks that slow down revenue.
launches.body:
### **tl;dr**

We work with specialist clinics to identify their biggest administrative blockers and deploy custom **AI** to resolve them. Right now, we’re automating **referral intake**, reducing the time it takes for clinics to process new patients and accelerate revenue collection.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u403AnLMSNE>

### **Problem**

Specialist clinics struggle with **slow, manual referral processing**, leading to revenue delays, administrative overload, and patient drop offs. The biggest bottlenecks we've uncovered:

* **Referral processing is manual and slow.** Clinics receive **thousands of referrals per month**, requiring extensive manual effort to extract and enter data.
* **Medical necessity verification is tedious.** Clinics must determine if a referral meets insurance criteria, often requiring **days of back-and-forth with primary care providers** for missing information.
* **Insurance approvals are a major roadblock.** Clinics waste **days negotiating with insurers** to confirm reimbursement eligibility before scheduling treatment.

These inefficiencies cause **40-60% of referrals to drop off and** costs the U.S. healthcare system **over $150 billion annually**. The administrative burden is also immense, with an average of **4.3 administrative staff per doctor** in the American healthcare system.

### **Solution**

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXduwoVo9LiyuYd4ldqDHoJxHu2uaKzKbOzQnI4MZ0vlWDvKTY-nE2iokzaFTCR7-7PeqhwdI9FIqtRbpP1FkZ3ivWq6TdtuyftWnKoMCyzw-smhtrM7tZacSCTnDkJ45wF92PRK7w?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

Cenote eliminates the **referral-to-treatment bottleneck**, allowing clinics to focus on patient care while accelerating revenue collection.

* **Automated data extraction:** We categorize and extract key referral details the moment they hit the clinic’s inbox.
* **Seamless medical necessity verification:** If critical referral data is missing, our system **auto-requests** the necessary information via the preferred form of digital communication.
* **AI-powered insurance authorization:** Our **AI callers** handle insurance approvals, freeing clinic staff to focus on higher-value tasks.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGgHkFuty55KGO5k--WHuaGP852o6tN4i7BepjytmDTjp48gCAx7ZC2boYhxw4NV9-evAIo09IUWh61gICroHpapc2X2jAmN3plFp4tpHM7ib9RKHwuqyyvd4FXxx2qQe-r7D7Uw?key=9LANEIwzbMw6NQWGiMH6ii1e)

Validate page allows staff to easily confirm extracted data

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87480&key=user_uploads/2213671/4398c4d4-4712-4460-a3a3-46107d03750d)

[Kofi](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kofi-ansong-89294016a/) was formerly a software engineer for [Promise](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/promise) (YC W18), a gov-tech company. He is leveraging his experience building AI products for state governments to delight folks in the healthcare industry.

[Ajani](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ajani-smith-washington/) spent 2.5 years before this as an early stage VC at Base10 -- investing $30M in seed and series A stage companies

[Kristy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gaoxk/) worked on carbon accounting engines at Watershed Climate and is experienced in working in highly regulated spaces. She developed a wide set of engineering expertise from her time at several tech companies, including Google, PayPal, Cockroach Labs.

launches.body:
Hey YC!

We’re [Raouf](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2360566) and [Rayan](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/2366179) — co-founders of G LNK

**TL;DR**

G LNK is an AI-powered platform that connects Pharma companies with doctors & researchers. Rayan worked on this as a consultant, where Pharma companies spent billions annually just to determine how much to pay doctors while staying within regulatory guidelines. Using LLMs, we’re automating the end-to-end process—from identifying candidates to compensation and compliance.\
<https://youtu.be/16oP6roNnZk>

**Problem**

Pharma companies spend over **$70 billion annually** on engaging doctors & researchers, yet a lot of that money is wasted on outdated and manual processes:

* **Outsourcing is expensive and slow**: Companies spend millions on third parties (consulting, recruiting, and regulatory firms)  just to find the right experts and to know how much to pay them compliantly.
* **Compliance risks are high**: Payment miscalculations can lead to regulatory violations and hefty fines
* **Data is scattered**: Contracts, payments and compliance tracking are spread across disconnected systems, making transparency and oversight difficult

<https://youtu.be/qDdFbMWO6eU>

**Solution**

**G LNK automates Pharma companies' entire healthcare professional (HCP) engagement process**—from identifying suitable doctors to engaging them. Here’s how it works:

1. **Identify HCPs:**
   * Identify a doctor from our database of over 3.2 million user profiles (growing 250% MoM).
   * Alternatively, if you know who you want to engage, simply upload the doctor’s CV and we will take care of the rest.
2. **Calculate Compensation:**
   * Instantly determine their compensation rates.
   * Adjust the rates dynamically based on factors such as service type and travel requirements.
3. **Engage Directly:**
   * Contact the selected doctors directly through our platform.
4. **Ensure Compliance:**
   * Maintain regulatory compliance and prevent compliance violations before they happen.
   * Leverage real-time data from trusted sources like NIH, PubMed, CBS, CMS, and more.

This step-by-step solution replaces multiple vendors with a single AI-powered platform, ensuring efficient, compliant, and cost-effective HCP engagement.

**Additional Features**

* **Built-in CRM** to track all HCP engagements
* **Comprehensive financial tracking**, including:
  * All Transfer of Value payments made to HCPs (date, purpose, associated drug)
  * Drug coverage breakdown
  * Monthly payment summaries
  * Payment analysis by Therapeutic Area
* **Tailored recommendations** for grants, conferences, and publications for HCPs
* **Centralized database** of regulations and Codes of Conduct across 150+ countries

**Team**

Rayan and Raouf have known each other for over a decade, with their professional relationship cementing itself during their time as researchers at the University of Chicago.

**Rayan (CEO)** worked as a Life-Sciences Consultant at PwC and was recognized as top consulting analyst in the US for pioneering automation in pharmaceutical compliance. He holds degrees in Chemistry & Economics at UChicago, where he was one of the youngest biochemistry researchers at Pritzker School of Engineering.

**Raouf (CTO)** worked as a ML-researcher at AxLab, where he specialized in developing neural network architectures for multimodal human-computer interaction with adaptive reinforcement learning. He has a multidisciplinary background, with degrees in Computer Science, Astrophysics, & Economics from UChicago

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88235&key=user_uploads/2366179/8a3b2573-1a0d-499b-b252-94260eb9ca1d)

**We are on a mission to help Pharma companies cut costs, enhance accuracy with better benchmarking, and save valuable time. By streamlining these critical processes, we empower Pharma to focus more resources on manufacturing, distribution, and supply—accelerating the delivery of life-changing treatments to those who need them most.**

**Our Asks**

We would really appreciate introductions to anyone working in the Pharma industry or any health-related verticals. Additionally, if you know any physician/research communities, we would love to talk and learn more!

launches.body:
### **Introducing Paratus – AI-Powered Patient Intake**

**TL;DR**

Patients wait months for an appointment, often with no guidance or symptom tracking in the meantime. When they finally see a doctor, the first 5-10 minutes of the visit are wasted gathering history instead of diagnosing and treating.

**Right now, there are only two ways to handle patient intake:**

* **Static intake forms** – Miss key details, forcing doctors to play catch-up.
* **Triage nurses** – Costly, difficult to scale, and still prone to oversight.

Paratus changes this. Our AI-powered intake assistant gathers symptoms, flags concerns, and delivers a structured clinical summary before the visit even starts—so doctors walk in fully informed.

Watch our demo [here](https://youtu.be/KHh7fp5svY8).

### **It’s Time for a New Wave of AI-Powered Intake**

✅ **Conversational AI engages patients before their visit,** collecting deeper insights than any form ever could.\
✅ **Doctor-approved triage** – Uses **500+ Schmitt-Thompson protocols** and cross-checks medical literature.\
✅ **Instant structured reports** – Doctors walk in fully prepared with:

* Symptom history & differential considerations
* Next steps & testing recommendations
* A pre-visit SOAP note for the EHR
* A full conversation transcript for review

**Think of it as a triage nurse who never misses a detail—at a fraction of the cost.**

### **How It Works**

1. **Instant Patient Connection** – The patient clicks an SMS link and connects with our AI assistant.
2. **Conversational AI Consultation** – Our AI dynamically adapts to responses, uncovering key details just like a triage nurse.
3. **Automated Pre-Visit Reports** – We run the full transcript through our fine-tuned LLM, extracting structured insights for the doctor.

### **The Problem: Long Waits & Inefficient Intake**

* **Months-long wait times** leave patients in limbo with no support.
* **Doctors start visits blind**, leading to rushed decisions and missed symptoms.
* **Triage nurses are expensive and inefficient**, yet essential for collecting high-quality data.

Paratus solves these problems, ensuring patients feel heard before their visit and doctors can focus on diagnosis, not data collection.

### **What Patients Are Saying**

_"I called as a mother for my son’s ear pain. I was impressed by the AI’s clarity, empathy, and ability to ask the right questions. Honestly, it was better to talk to than a real nurse!"_

### **Why Us?**

Best friends Tannen Hall and Pablo Bermudez-Canete, both AI students from Stanford, founded Paratus Health to fix a problem they experienced firsthand—the broken patient intake process.

For 11 years, Tannen watched his family members - and himself - grow sicker without a diagnosis for a rare disease. They endured months-long waits for every appointment, only to leave with more questions than answers. Each new doctor started from scratch, missing critical details that could have led to the right diagnosis sooner. By the time they finally got answers, it was too late to undo the damage.

That experience left Tannen frustrated with a system that forces patients to wait in limbo while their health deteriorates. He wrote about this problem in his Stanford application, and today, there is no one more determined to fix it.

Now, he and Pablo are building Paratus, an AI-powered intake platform that ensures no patient is left waiting without support and no doctor walks in unprepared.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87836&key=user_uploads/1786718/3a9b560c-8f62-4376-9297-67a19ff14f04)

### **Our Vision**

A world where doctors walk in ready to diagnose, not gather symptoms- because every patient’s full story is already in their hands.

### **Our Ask**

We’re currently running pilots and looking to connect with:

* Hospitals
* Physician offices
* Outpatient facilities
* Private clinics

Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/pablo-paratushealth/30min?month=2025-02)!

If you know someone who should see this, we’d love an introduction! Reach us at [pablo@paratushealth.com](https://mailto:pablo@paratushealth.com) or on [linkedin!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/paratushealth/)

**Let’s fix patient intake - so doctors can focus on care.**

launches.body:
Hey YC [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re [Max B](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maximeberthelot/), [Baptiste](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bdebever/), and [Max G](https://www.linkedin.com/in/maxguerois/) - co-founders of [Lucis](https://www.lucis.life/).

### **TL;DR**

**Lucis turns regular blood tests into actionable health insights - so people can act before it’s too late.** In 4 months, we’ve helped 500 people in Paris get ahead of chronic diseases. Today, we’re expanding across Europe.

https://youtu.be/a5fX1K5hnvU

### **The Problem In Europe**

85% of deaths are caused by preventable chronic diseases. That’s more than 4 million lives lost every year just in Europe. Yet, the healthcare system remains reactive, and people receive care only after something goes wrong.

Those seeking comprehensive preventive care, including blood testing, analysis, and expert guidance, typically resort to private longevity clinics that charge over €50K per year. **Such premium healthcare remains inaccessible to the vast majority of people.**

### **Lucis: Health Insights in Your Pocket**

_“If you're tired of being in the dark about your health, not knowing where you stand or what to do next, Lucis is built for you.”_

Lucis goes beyond vague checkups and unreadable lab reports. It provides a clear health baseline, tracks progress over time, and translates complex biomarker data into personalized guidance people can actually implement in their daily lives. All at a fraction of the cost of a private clinic.

You’ll get answers to questions like:

_"Am I aging faster than I should?"_

_"Is my testosterone at a healthy level for my age?"_

_"How can I improve my next marathon performance?"_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90454&key=user_uploads/1454634/0a347d82-7c9b-4fef-8c72-bf70511ce761)

Here’s how it works:

* 2 full health check-ups per year
* See how your body’s doing with 15 health scores and your biological age - and track your progress over time.
* Personalized action plan across nutrition, sleep, and movement
* Access to longevity add-on tests, like microbiome, continuous glucose monitoring, and food sensitivity tests.

### **The Team**

We started Lucis because we’ve lived the problem ourselves.

Baptiste lost a close relative to a condition that could’ve been caught earlier. Max B has spent the last decade deep in biohacking, testing everything from supplements to wearables. At 27, Max G turned his health into an experiment - tracking sleep, diet, and training - and improved nearly all of his biomarkers in the process. We know what it’s like to search for clarity and get none.

**Lucis is what we wish we had - and now, we’re building it for everyone else.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90454&key=user_uploads/1454634/830d7470-4a85-446e-b427-38ec7343d441)

### **Since launching our beta just 4 months ago:**

* **30,000+ people** have joined our European longevity community.
* **30+ lab locations** opened across France
* **2 new European cities** - now live in Lisbon 🇵🇹 and London 🇬🇧
* **500+ people in Paris** used Lucis to get ahead of chronic illness
* **10 AI Startups** have gifted Lucis as a health benefit for their employees

## 

### **Our Vision**

**Lucis isn’t just a product - we’re building a completely new healthcare system in Europe.** One that lives with you. And works for you quietly, every day.

We started with blood, but our ambition goes far beyond a single input. We are building Lucis, the intelligence layer for your health. Right in your pocket.

If this resonates with you

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
Our mission is personal. Each of us watched someone we love slip through the cracks of today’s healthcare system. Peter’s grandfather suffered three preventable ER readmissions before passing—his ruptured aorta went undetected after missed medications and a complete absence of follow-up care. Lukas’s grandmother, who raised him, deteriorated in assisted living—isolated, depressed, and unrecognizable before passing unexpectedly just days before he arrived. Kazuki’s grandfather battled cancer alone in Japan, cut off from family by COVID-era hospital restrictions—reminding us that healing requires more than medicine.

What we experienced is not rare. It’s the reality for tens of millions of older adults. In ERs, nursing homes, and senior communities where we’ve volunteered, we saw the same  patterns: chronic conditions unmanaged, dangerous falls ignored, weeks without human connection, and emergencies that could have been prevented. Aging has become a quiet crisis—fueled by staff shortages, fragmented systems, lack of technology access, and stigma about growing old. 

We’ve invested 600+ hours on the ground working with older adults to deeply understand their’ needs, motivations, and barriers. Our team brings full-stack software, AI/ML, and hardware expertise from Neuralink, Stanford, and NVIDIA, along with operating experience leading major organizations like Zero2One (largest startup group at UIUC), Stanford Founders (1,500+ members), and Covalence (2,000 volunteers across seven universities)—this gives us the tools needed to lead transformation in this space. 

We’re here because we believe older adults deserve independence, dignity, and a healthcare system that truly cares—and we’re building Kaigo Health to make that the new standard.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our vision is to transform healthcare into a continuous, preventative, and home-based experience. We start by enabling high touch outpatient care for Medicare providers, supercharging value-based care. This builds consumer trust and a proprietary data layer, and leverages existing provider distribution networks to later phase in more advanced ambient sensing and care delivery technologies (e.g. home robot companions) for 24/7 personal health management - bringing healthcare to the home while hospitals focus on acute care.

launches.body:
**TLDR;** We help healthcare providers care for patients at home by automating follow-ups, check-ins, and monitoring - closing care gaps and catching issues before they become emergencies.\
\
https://youtu.be/c2BLsZJtZSg

**The Problem**

After every visit, patient care falls apart between systems.

Follow-ups, care plan adherence, and patient monitoring are manual, time consuming, and insufficient - leaving patients unsupported, nurses overloaded, and health systems losing billions to readmissions and other penalties.

**Our Solution**

Kaigo Health builds an **AI outpatient care workforce** - autonomous agents that continuously follow-up, monitor, and advocate for patients, then report back to their human care teams with actionable insights. All of this is delivered through simple, accessible phone calls with a voice agent specifically designed for older adults.

Kaigo **helps providers scale outpatient care management 100× without scaling headcount**, driving fewer readmissions, higher quality scores, and stronger value-based performance.

**Vision**

Kaigo aims to build a new infrastructure for healthcare beyond the 4 walls of the clinic - a layer of autonomous, scalable health monitoring, coordination, and delivery that seamlessly fills in the gaps between our current fragmented system, transforming healthcare into a continuous, ambient part of everyday life.

We’re starting with providers: giving them powerful technology to dramatically expand their outpatient care capacity, thrive under value-based care, and ensure every patient has a proactive, friendly voice looking out for their health between visits.

**Our Story**

We started Kaigo after seeing how fragile recovery becomes once patients leave the hospital. Our families wanted to stay healthy, yet support faded the moment they got home. We’re building Kaigo so care continues where life happens.

launches.title: Rovi Health: Text-based healthcare that slashes employer health spend
launches.tagline: We deliver high-quality, affordable healthcare to employees through text. Employers cut 10-20% of their annual spend. Employees get concierge healthcare they love.
launches.body:
# **⏳TL/DR**

Rovi helps employees access high-quality, cost-effective healthcare. We text employees the best in-network options at exactly the right moment, and handle all the complexity.

* Our AI-enabled virtual care treats common conditions quickly over text or video.
* For complex care, our AI agents search across all in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, then handle scheduling and logistics.
* Employees get rewarded for choosing high-value care through copay reimbursements and waived deductibles.

Launch video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mKNB0CF8_9Y

# **⚠️ The Problem**

Healthcare costs are crushing employers. 2025 is seeing a 9% rate hike, the worst in a decade. A 1,000-person company now faces over $1M in cost increases annually, compounding.

Employers’ only options are to cut benefits or redesign their entire plan. Both take months and frustrate employees.

What if Employers could offset these costs by adding benefits instead?

## **🤨 How is this possible?**

**Price and quality have no correlation in healthcare:**

* The same MRI: $700 at an imaging center vs $2,500 at a hospital. Same network. Same machine.
* The same knee surgery: $7,000 at a surgery center vs $25,000 at a hospital. Same surgeon. Often better outcomes at the surgery center.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94971&key=user_uploads/1230817/7a7a2b27-4c82-410c-9744-82a5af6b1cc2)

**So why does everyone end up with the expensive option?**

1. **Hospitals own the referral pipeline.** They consolidated most primary care practices. When your doctor orders a procedure, their systems automatically directs it to their expensive facilities.
2. **Shopping is impossible.** Prices are hidden, provider directors outdated, quality is opaque. And when you're sick, calling twelve clinics is the last thing you want to do.

**Rovi does the hard work.** Our AI agents analyze terabytes of pricing data, research every provider's quality metrics, and surface options matching each person's preferences for cost, convenience, and availability. Making good healthcare decisions drives down costs for both the employee and the employer.

# **🎯 Impact**

We save employers 10-20% on healthcare spend while improving care outcomes and delivering a health benefit that employees love.

We've already signed contracts to roll out to thousands of employees across multiple employers for the 2025-2026 plan year.

## **🙏🏾 Our ask**

1. **Employers:** We have two final Q1 spots for self-funded employers. Introductions to employer benefits teams, brokers, health plans, and TPAs are welcome. Reach out to [santosh@rovihealth.com](mailto:santosh@rovihealth.com).
2. **Individuals:** [**Join our beta**](https://rovi.health/) to try our AI care concierge. Rovi will find you great in-network doctors whenever you need care. Virtual care coming soon.

## **👬🏾 Our team**

We're brothers on a mission to build AI-native health insurance that members love.

**Santosh** was previously building Cedar's affordability products, scaling to millions in ARR by closing enterprise deals with the country's largest hospital systems. Before that, he led a 30-person GTM & Customer Success team at AngelList. He’s also a licensed health insurance broker.

**Tarun** built foundational AI models to predict extreme weather events at UChicago, where he earned a Master's in AI and high-performance computing. He has a B.S. in biology from Cornell, and is obsessed with using AI to solve healthcare's messiest data problems.

[_Imperfect (YC P26): Training that Adapts to Real Life_](https://youtu.be/xVmMhqS0eZg?si=YEs6nieLNYDwXPVo)

### **For the imperfect ones**

If another health tool tells me to reduce my stress level, I swear I'll throw it out the window. I'm not going to be "Fully Optimized" or want "Maximum Suffering!!!". I'm a 41-year-old founder/ultramarathoner with scoliosis. I need something that'll adapt to prioritizing a launch, working late, or prepping for Demo Day.

When Imperfect recommends 30g of protein after my hill repeats, I can have it switch the units to tacos. I measure carbs in basmati rice, not in grams. (Persian-American, 7 years in Mexico City before moving back to SF. Cultural references get mixed.)

### **How can you have your training, diet, and hydration adapt to your life?**

name: Floracene
long_description:
Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team.

The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production.

A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption.

Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.

launches.title: Omanta: A personal research lab dedicated to each patient.
launches.tagline: A research lab, for one.
launches.body:
Hey YC! We're Alfredo and Ranad, the founders of Omanta.

**TL;DR: Omanta creates a personalized research lab around a single patient. We integrate a patient’s complete medical record, personal genomics, and use AI to take on the most complex cancer cases. Our researchers tackled GitLab co-founder Sid Sijbrandij’s case, helping bring him into complete remission.**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkZaq_fENqI>

\
**Why this matters**\
If you're a cancer patient, you'd think the hardest cases have entire teams dedicated to solving them. The reality: most doctors have about 20 minutes per patient, while the science never stops moving. New discoveries emerge every day, yet reaching standard clinical care can take over a decade (\~17 years on average). Physicians make high-stakes decisions with limited time, and even the most difficult cases rarely have anyone whose full-time job is to interrogate every layer of that one patient's disease and push the newest science toward their treatment.

That's the gap we built Omanta to close.\
\
**What we do**\
We meet patients wherever they are in their journey. We integrate their complete medical record and personal genomics with AI and clinical evidence to understand the molecular drivers of their disease. Then we map every existing therapy against their biology, and if the right therapy doesn't exist, we build it, from cancer vaccines and immunotherapies to highly targeted radioligand therapies.\
\
We've worked on some of the most complex cancer cases in the world. Most notably, **Alfredo was the genomics lead for the personalized therapeutic campaign behind GitLab founder Sid Sijbrandij's complete remission**, partnering with leading institutions to pursue personalized mRNA/DNA vaccines, CAR-T programs, drug repurposing, expanded-access therapies, and continuous molecular monitoring. We've seen what becomes possible when the full force of modern science is organized around a single person, and Omanta brings that depth of investigation to every case.\
\
**Why us**\
We met eight years ago working on early CRISPR cancer research and have been building toward this ever since.

* **Alfredo Gonzalez, PhD (CEO)** — translational genomics. Led the year-long investigation of 25TB of sequencing and molecular data for Sid Sijbrandij, key missing information in existing genomic reports, and uncovered actionable findings that reshaped his therapeutic strategy, including personalized mRNA/DNA vaccines, CAR-T, expanded access, drug repurposing, and continuous monitoring. PhD at UCLA, where he built one of the world's largest centralized multi-omic datasets for rare tumors. Previously at the Broad Institute (Cancer Dependency Map, validating targets from large-scale CRISPR screens) and Harvard's Wagers Lab.
* **Ranad Humeidi, PhD (CSO)** — chemical biologist. Earned her PhD in Chemical Biology from Harvard in three years, where she identified a druggable mechanism in ulcerative colitis that became the basis of a multimillion-dollar GSK collaboration. Built and directed a multimillion-dollar scientific program centered on a single rare-cancer patient, then went on to direct scientific strategy for 12+ medically complex patients after standard options were exhausted. At the Broad, she co-created and co-led a fellowship turning scientific discoveries into companies.

\
**Our ask**

* Intros. If you or someone you love is facing a difficult cancer diagnosis, we want to hear from you.
* We're also looking to connect with physicians who want a dedicated research team behind their most complex cases.
* Reach us here on Bookface or at [alfredo@omanta.com](mailto:alfredo@omanta.com) & [ranad@omanta.com](mailto:ranad@omanta.com).

[omanta.com](http://omanta.com)\
